name: product_error_read_v14_package
purpose: Decision 66 in aromir, 18 Nov 2026: the second route for v1.4, now carried. The registry's carried measurement networks read as product_error_read_v14clean read them, and checked against aromir's own read (`--package`: probes/results_m1/aromir_v14_release_2026-11-18/product_error.json, aromir's code on the stored Hessians in the corpus atom order) to 0.01 cm-1 in every family and set; the carried record is rewritten with that check, which tests/test_m08_licence_pin.py::test_the_carried_record_agrees_with_the_package reads.

estimate.basis: product_error_read_v14clean read the same 48 molecules with the same three checkpoints in 102 s on 17 Nov 2026 (its record's run.seconds)

memory.basis: product_error_read_v14clean peaked at 0.37 GB (its record's run.peak_memory_gb); it holds one molecule at a time
